TZA.note: 152 institutions connected to the NIDA database is not stated to be an authentication service.
Gives 23,718,060 NINs but no population figure or share in the document.
Module upgrades are stated without saying who operates or owns the system.
No public register keyed on the NIN is named.

facts.fact: The Deputy Minister for Home Affairs told a parliamentary committee on 2026-10-22 that NIDA had generated 23,718,060 National Identification Numbers and produced 21,526,594 identity cards, 21,515,793 distributed.
facts.system: NIDA national identification numbers and cards
